title: Verifying Agents in Rubric-Graded Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.22841v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As AI agents take on increasingly open-ended and complex tasks, verifying their outputs has proven to be difficult. Rubric-graded agent environments, where a verifier judges multiple natural-language criteria against the deliverables and environment state changes produced by the agent, have emerged as a popular paradigm. We conduct the first systematic study of verifiers for rubric-graded agent environments. First, we create BankerVerifierBench (BVB), a meta-evaluation dataset of 2,464 human-judged rubric criteria across 24 investment-banking tasks. Next, we develop a methodology that derives from any rubric corpus the capabilities a verifier should possess, yielding a nine-capability taxonomy that we distill into three general design principles---reactive verification, environment alignment, and domain guidance---which we implement in Gandalf, an open-source verifier. Finally, we evaluate Gandalf against three existing verifiers on BVB.

translated_title: 基于评分标准评价环境中的智能体验证
translated_abstract: 随着AI智能体承担越来越开放和复杂的任务，验证其输出已被证明是困难的。基于评分标准的智能体环境——即由验证者根据智能体产生的交付物和环境状态变化来评判多个自然语言标准——已成为一种流行的范式。我们对基于评分标准的智能体环境中的验证者进行了首次系统性研究。首先，我们创建了BankerVerifierBench（BVB），这是一个包含2,464条人工评判的评分标准、覆盖24个投资银行任务的元评估数据集。接下来，我们开发了一种方法，能够从任何评分标准语料库中推导出验证者应具备的能力，形成一个九能力分类体系，并将其提炼为三个通用设计原则——响应式验证、环境对齐和领域指导——我们在开源验证者Gandalf中实现了这些原则。最后，我们在BVB上将Gandalf与三个现有验证者进行了评估比较。
tldr: 该论文首次系统研究了基于评分标准的智能体环境中的验证者，构建了包含2,464条人工评判评分标准的BankerVerifierBench元评估数据集，提出九能力分类体系并提炼出响应式验证、环境对齐和领域指导三大设计原则，据此实现了开源验证者Gandalf。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic study of verifiers for rubric-graded agent environments, introducing BankerVerifierBench (a meta-evaluation dataset of 2,464 human-judged rubric criteria across 24 investment-banking tasks), a nine-capability taxonomy distilled into three design principles, and Gandalf, an open-source verifier built on those principles.
